title: Feature request: dates in careportal
body: IMPROVEMENT In the care portal, information is separated by day by a gray bar containing text. The first 7 days feature texts such as "today", "yesterday", "2 days ago", etc. Starting from the 8th day, hard dates appear as text. If you are looking for something within the first 7 days, it requires some calculation to determine the correct date. If you analyze a screenshot of one of the first days, it is not even immediately possible to determine which date it concerns. Unnecessarily difficult. Proposal to replace the vague indications above the first 7 days with a hard date. Perhaps supplement this for the first 7 days with "Monday", "Tuesday", etc. Jan van den Berg

comments.body:
It was dates for all days a looong time ago.
Then someone proposed a "user friendly" presentation for recent days (today, yesterday...).

I agree that having dates is sometimes easier to identify one specific day in the history 🤔.

I think we have enough space to show both (even in low res phone), so I will propose an improvement in a while 😉.
